_readme: The active design system. scripts/render.py (via portfolio.py build) turns this into assets/css/tokens.css. A MINOR replaces this file and restyles assets/css/main.css; a MAJOR also rewrites scripts/render.py and assets/js/main.js. The first theme listed is the default. validate enforces WCAG contrast on every theme. fonts.display and fonts.mono are optional extra stacks (emitted as --font-display and --font-mono).
name: Cover block
concept: The page is detailed like a reinforcement cage before the pour. Every panel is a stirrup: soft bend-radius corners on three sides and a tight hooked corner where the 135-degree hook closes, with a short hook leg drawn past it. Buttons and chips sit on round cover blocks (the concrete spacers that hold bars off the shutter), lists are threaded with tie-wire dots, and headings are set in a soft optical serif like the lettering on a hand-drawn bending schedule. Signature motion: stirrup trace. As each activity and panel scrolls into view, its outline is drawn bar by bar (top leg, side, bottom, side, then the hook) on a CSS view() timeline, the way a detailer draws a stirrup.

fonts.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
